scenes.text: Welcome to Cumulus. Millions of AI agents—from ChatGPT and Claude to shopping bots—browse the web daily to answer questions and purchase products. Yet most websites fail because of client-side hydration, missing schema, blocked robots directives, or broken checkout links. We built Cumulus to audit how easily AI agents can discover, access, understand, and transact on your website.
scenes.caption:
Cumulus · AI Website Readiness Auditor
Why we made it: Websites fail for autonomous AI agents

scenes.text: Getting started requires zero signup. Enter any public URL and click Audit. Cumulus launches a multi-stage evaluation: parsing robots directives for major AI crawlers, probing sitemaps, extracting raw HTML, and launching a headless browser to execute real agent journeys.
scenes.caption:
Live Walkthrough: URL Submission & Real-time Evaluation
Multi-stage crawl with Server-Sent Events (SSE)

scenes.text: Unlike basic scanners, Cumulus tests real user workflows in a sandboxed browser: finding pricing, extracting plans, following checkout calls-to-action without submitting forms, and verifying that navigation landmarks are truly machine-followable.
scenes.caption:
Deep Browser Agent Testing
Evaluating pricing, plan extraction, checkout links, and navigation

scenes.text: When complete, Cumulus generates a transparent report. The overall readiness score reflects verified evidence across Discovery, Access, Usability, and Payments. Crucially, audit coverage is always measured—untested or inconclusive checks are never treated as failures.
scenes.caption:
Transparent Results Dashboard & Scoring
Discovery, Access, Usability & Payments with verified coverage

scenes.text: Every finding comes backed by real evidence, business impact, and specific acceptance criteria. Engineers can download the complete Fix Kit: a packaged ZIP archive with individual Markdown guides and verification commands ready for sprint backlog.
scenes.caption:
Evidence-Backed Findings & Downloadable Fix Kit
Packaged Markdown remediation guides for engineering teams

scenes.text: Cumulus is built for developers and autonomous agents alike. Our documentation details all thirty-three checks in the suite. With our REST API and native Model Context Protocol interface, AI agents can audit websites and retrieve remediation instructions programmatically.
scenes.caption:
Complete Documentation, REST API & Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Equipping autonomous agents with audit & remediation tools

scenes.text: Test your site today with Cumulus, and make your business ready for the agentic web.
scenes.caption: Cumulus · Ready for the Agentic Web
